## CARD 1: 🏗 EXPERIENCE & ELIGIBILITY AGENT
Deterministic verification of past project performance.
Verifies similar works count, value thresholds, completion date bounds, and certificate validity.

## CARD 2: ⚙️ DETERMINISTIC ELIGIBILITY RULES
Strict mathematical verification:
• Minimum similar works count threshold
• Individual contract value minimums
• Look-back experience period calculation
• Mandatory completion certificate presence
• Technical similarity compliance
